news.title: SC stays issuance of work order till Aug 13 in Bandra, Worli cluster redevelopment projects
news.para: The Supreme Court has temporarily halted work orders for cluster redevelopment projects.  These projects involve 132 acres in Bandra Reclamation and Worli areas.  Housing societies had challenged the government's decision to redevelop these lands.  The apex court will hear the matter again on August 13.  Until then, no work orders for the redevelopment will be issued.

news.title: RWA moves NGT against SEIAA stand on Amaltash environmental clearance in Gurugram
news.para: The National Green Tribunal is hearing a challenge to Haryana's environmental clearance for a Gurugram project.  Amaltash Residential Welfare Association has four weeks to file objections to a compliance report.  SEIAA granted clearance despite recommendations for a fresh traffic impact assessment.  A committee found traffic management relied on internal roads through residential areas.  The tribunal will next hear the matter on October sixteenth.

news.title: Tamil Nadu registration dept to classify streets into three categories based on electricity connections
news.para: Tamil Nadu's registration department is correcting market value guideline anomalies. Streets will now be classified based on commercial electricity connections. This aims to reduce the gap between guideline and actual market values. Inconsistencies in valuations of roads and adjoining areas will be reviewed. Manpower shortages may affect the implementation of these important changes.

news.title: Gujarat: Real estate projects hit as new appraisal panel not formed
news.para: Real estate project clearances in Gujarat have slowed significantly. The State-level Expert Appraisal Committee's tenure ended in June, causing delays. Industry representatives have raised concerns with the state government. Many project approvals are currently stuck without a functioning committee. The formation of a new committee is reportedly in its final stages.

news.title: NAB home-loan applications fall 15% as Australian housing market cools
news.para: National Australia Bank saw home loan applications drop fifteen percent.  Business lending showed early stress, particularly in Middle East conflict-affected sectors.  Watch loans increased eight percent, indicating growing customer strain.  Asset quality pressure remained evident in construction and transport industries.  Impaired loans improved, showing active management of bad debts.

news.title: Prestige Estates Projects’ net profit declines 13% to ₹271.40 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Prestige Estates Projects’ consolidated total income increased 14.9 per cent to ₹2,835.60 crore. Its sales value declined 46 per cent year-on-year to ₹6,579.30 crore, while collections rose six per cent to ₹4,802.20 crore.

news.title: Brigade acquires two acres land in Bengaluru; Prestige to develop 14.6 acres land in Thane
news.para: Brigade Group has acquired land on Kanakapura Road for a premium residential project. This new development is estimated to have a gross development value of ₹400 crore. Meanwhile, Prestige Group announced a partnership for a large residential project in Thane. This Thane project will span over fourteen acres and has a GDV of ₹6,000 crore. The development of this significant project is expected to occur in multiple phases.

news.title: EFC (I)’s net profit rises 52% to ₹70.85 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: EFC (I)'s consolidated total income increased 31.8 per cent to ₹294.29 crore during the quarter. Its board has also approved the demerger of the asset-light managed office business of its wholly owned subsidiary, EFC.

news.title: Bajaj Housing Finance’s net profit rises 23% to ₹715.28 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Bajaj Housing Finance's total income increased 17.1 per cent to ₹3,063.05 crore during the quarter. Its assets under management grew 24 per cent year-on-year to ₹1,49,624 crore.

news.title: Asian Paints’ net profit rises 40% to ₹1,559.45 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Asian Paints' consolidated total income increased 18.1 per cent to ₹10,782.79 crore during the quarter. Its decorative paints business in India reported volume growth of nine per cent and value growth of 16.6 per cent.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh set to ease building norms in industrial hubs
news.para: Uttar Pradesh is set to introduce uniform building regulations across its industrial development authorities.  The draft proposes simpler approval processes and higher development potential for investors.  Key proposals include relaxed floor area ratio norms and self-certification for small plots.  Industrial plots over four acres will require dormitory facilities, and data centers get relaxed norms.  These reforms aim to boost investment and planned urban development in the state.

news.title: Patna civic body launches drive to bring all flats under property tax net
news.para: The Patna Municipal Corporation has initiated a citywide campaign to tax all multi-storey building flats. Apartment secretaries must provide detailed flat information for accurate tax assessments. Sanitary inspectors will conduct field visits to verify building details and flat numbers. Revenue officers will scrutinize collected data and finalize property tax assessments. This initiative aims to enhance revenue collection and improve civic services.

news.title: Fashion & apparel accounts for 40% of retail leasing in H1 2026: Report
news.para: Retail leasing in India rose 20% year-on-year to about 3.9 million sq ft in H1 2026, according to CBRE. Fashion & apparel remained the largest category, accounting for about 40% of overall space take-up.

news.title: Rajaji Nagar housing project nears occupancy as final utility connection awaits
news.para: The Rajaji Nagar housing project's first phase is nearly complete and ready for occupation. Beneficiary families will begin moving into new apartments by the second week of August. This marks a significant milestone in the redevelopment of the densely populated settlement.  The project aims to transform the area into a modern, planned residential neighborhood.  Authorities hope this success will accelerate the remaining phases of the urban renewal initiative.

news.title: Villagers without property documents deprived government schemes in Chikkamagaluru
news.para: Many houses in Narasimharajapura taluk lack essential property documents and e-Khata. This prevents thousands of villagers from accessing crucial government facilities and benefits. Revenue officials report a significant number of applications for property documents have been rejected. Joint surveys are underway to resolve issues concerning houses built on forest and government land. Policy decisions are required to address the challenges faced by these residents.

news.title: Office leasing rises 7% to 41.6 million sq ft in H1 2026: Report
news.para: Office space absorption across India’s top six cities stood at 41.6 million sq ft in H1 2026, up 7% year-on-year, according to Savills India. New supply declined 5% to 23.7 million sq ft, while vacancy fell to 13.2%.

news.title: Mumbai court acquits builder in 44-year-old FSI fraud case
news.para: A city builder was acquitted in a forty-four-year-old land measurement manipulation case.  The special court cited a significant lack of evidence for conviction.  The prosecution failed to prove any offense against the sole surviving accused.  Several witnesses were untraceable or deceased by the time the trial began.  The court noted charges of criminal misconduct do not apply to builders.

news.title: BMC clears removal of 126 trees for Powai SRA project; developer to provide 4,000 PAP homes
news.para: The BMC Tree Authority approved removing 126 trees for a Powai slum rehabilitation project.  This decision followed the developer's commitment to provide over 4,000 free rehabilitation flats.  Officials surveyed the site and identified 144 trees, with 126 affected by construction.  The authority permitted felling 44 trees and transplanting 82 others.  This new approval supersedes an earlier one due to redevelopment layout changes.

news.title: Chandigarh reviews online tenancy portal ahead of launch
news.para: Chandigarh administration reviewed an online Tenancy Portal for upcoming rules.  The portal will facilitate registration of tenancy agreements and UIN generation.  It aims to formalize the rental housing sector and resolve disputes efficiently.  Officials were directed to ensure the portal is user-friendly and accessible.  The new tenancy rules are expected to streamline rental processes for residents.

news.title: Bhubaneswar civic body to intensify action against building plan violations ahead of SC hearing
news.para: Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation will activate enforcement squads to address building plan deviations.  This action follows Supreme Court scrutiny over unauthorized constructions nationwide.  The civic body will submit an action taken report to the apex court soon.  Inspections will identify violations like extra floors and encroachments on setbacks.  The move aligns with Supreme Court directives on building compliance and regulatory issues.
